item.title: Ask HN: How do you prove two machines computed the same float32 result?
item.summary: Not approximately the same. Bit-identical. Across different hardware vendors, kernel versions, or driver stacks. Logs and weight checksums don't answer this. Looking for anyone who has a working production answer or has hit this wall. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49322548 Points: 4 # Comments: 1
